verdict.rationale: Expensify offers card integration (BYOC), SmartScan receipt capture, and a dedicated travel management product that claims to prevent 'a pile of receipts,' suggesting some automatic collection of trip-related expenses into a report. However, there's no concrete documentation showing bookings, cards, and receipts are explicitly linked to a single itinerary, and community reports describe frequent categorization errors and reliance on manual/mechanical-turk processing rather than fully automatic collection. Missing for 10: explicit itinerary-linking mechanism, evidence of booking data import (flights/hotels) feeding the same report, and independent confirmation that collection is reliable/automatic rather than error-prone.
